Homozygous or compound heterozygous AVIL variants (p.Leu425Met homozygous; p.Arg135Gln with p.Phe656Valfs*7; p.Leu425Met with p.Arg446His) were found in three families with SRNS. ClinGen records loss of function as the proposed mechanism. Advillin's molecular function is actin filament binding; the activity is marked ABNORMAL rather than DECREASED because every tested patient allele loses filament bundling, but only the truncating allele loses F-actin binding itself.
